topic: Classifying Matter as Solid, Liquid, or Gas
key_concepts: Matter exists in three states: solid, liquid, and gas
Solids have a fixed shape and volume
Liquids take the shape of their container and can flow
Gases expand to fill the available space
Common household objects can be classified as solid, liquid, or gas
Common classroom objects can be classified as solid, liquid, or gas
